svg.text: Voynich Phytoglyphica pharmaceutical decoding engine: a session-based system that routes Voynich Manuscript herbal monographs through three structural gates using the 12-primitive Imscribing Grammar as parameter set, then extracts and elaborates recipe steps from the pharmaceutical folios.
